scope: R3.4 held-out phase-1 coding validation at the frozen personal Gaussian SNR; R4 remains separate
external_requirement: Identify error levels where the coded path succeeds and the uncoded path fails; the external supplies no numerical quality threshold
primary_metric: Whole-record 96000-sample NMSE against the original 48 kHz NPY, retaining boundaries and cross terms
baseline_source: Frozen R3.3 imported p=0 Hamming summary: mean MSE of five phase-0 inputs divided by original mean-square power
threshold_reason: Allow at most one design-baseline MSE of additional total distortion, equivalent to a factor-two total MSE budget (3.01029995664 dB); declared project preference, not a external or perceptual standard
success_definition: Population mean reconstruction quality under new noise draws; not a guarantee of every record passing or of bit-perfect messages
confidence_family: 30 means: two paths times all 15 conditions, including identity and stress cases
interval_scope: Bonferroni-adjusted approximate simultaneous 95% mean intervals; t/CLT approximation for independent records, not exact finite-sample normality or a continuous-p band
classification: Pass if upper<=tau; fail if lower>tau; otherwise inconclusive. Gain requires coded pass and uncoded fail at the same tested p.

sample_size_planning.source: R3.3 phase-0 trials only; five input banks with eight BSC masks each
sample_size_planning.rule: Smallest multiple of 50, at least 200, with planned adjusted t half-width <=0.1*tau for both boundary-adjacent pilot cases
sample_size_planning.limitation: Five-bank variance estimates are a planning heuristic, not a power or precision guarantee; sample size will not be changed after validation

additional_conditions.role: predeclared transition refinement below the p=0.003 pilot
predeclared transition refinement above the p=0.003 pilot

range_rule: Retain every R3.3 point, including the personal point, identity and stress points; add three within-range refinements before validation; do not change the personal mapping or main endpoints
pairing: One new Gaussian input and quantised payload shared by all p and both codes within a record; different p/layout leaves have separate BSC masks
identity_rng: p=0 is an exact roundtrip without an RNG draw
no_phase0_imports: No design observation is included in validation; only the already frozen choices and planning summaries are reused
secondary_metrics: real channel and data BER counts
full-message block failures and actual block weights
bit-perfect complete-payload records with pointwise exact binomial intervals
paired NMSE difference and paired reconstruction-MSE gain in dB, pointwise exploratory intervals
per-record waveform pass counts under the shared threshold
gain_reporting: Discrete tested probability set and pass/fail brackets only; do not claim an exact continuous transition or an Eb/N0 coding gain
validation_feedback: No threshold, code, quantiser, filter, grid or repeat-count changes after inspecting phase-1 outputs
